title: Chapter 247 Go Together
content:
Chapter 247 Go Together

As Bai Lushuang opened her mouth, the entire alchemy meeting instantly calmed down again.

This is the influence of Bai Lu Frost here.

Immediately, several disciples of the Alchemy Peak escorted a young man toward this place.

Several people threw him in front of Bai Lushuang, and they all said indignantly: "Sister Bai, it's this kid who came and yelled, causing me to destroy all the pot of elixirs."

"Yes, I ruined my pot of elixir and it turned into a slag."

"What are you?! I even exploded the alchemy furnace!!"

Several young alchemists vented their dissatisfaction and anger in their hearts.

Hearing these words, Bai Lushuang also frowned slightly and looked at the young man in front of him. Bai Lushuang slowly said, "Junior Brother Tao, why are you noisy here for no reason? You should know where this place is, right?"

The man in front of him is also a disciple of their Alchemy Peak.

The relationship is pretty good on weekdays.

But this time, this disciple of Dan Peak obviously suffered public anger.

Faced with Bai Lushuang's questioning, the disciple of the Alchemy Peak burst into tears.

At this moment, everyone was a little confused and looked at him in a daze and burst into tears.

It seems that it is extremely aggrieved.

Everyone frowned, and after a long time, he choked and said, "Sister Bai, I received the news that the teacher is going to compete with the alchemist there in the Wood Fairy Realm. In desperation, he rushed back to notify you."

"I, I really didn't mean to disturb you in refining elixirs."

As soon as these words came out, everyone present was shocked.

"impossible!"

"How could the teacher go to the Wood Fairy Realm to compete with the alchemist there?!"

"That's right, who is worthy of competing with the teacher?"

Not only did the disciples of Liandan Peak not believe this, but the other students around him who were watching the show also looked incredible.

At this time, a disciple of the Dan Peak stepped forward and grabbed his collar and angrily shouted: "Where did you hear the wild news from? If this is fake, I will never end up with you!"

In his heart, Jordan Yang's image is extremely majestic.

Competing with the alchemist in the Wood Immortal Realm is simply an insult to his teacher.

This is absolutely not allowed.

"Senior brother, I, what I said is true. Many people have already rushed to the Wood Fairy Realm."

The disciple of the Alchemy Peak quickly explained.

Just as the argument was still going to continue, Bai Lushuang spoke.

"Okay, that's it."

Then, Bai Lushuang looked at the disciple of Liandan Peak and said in a deep voice: "I tell you that others believe in this matter, it is someone else's business, but we are different. We are disciples of Liandan Peak and students of teachers. ”

"Not to mention whether the teacher will compete with other alchemists, it is almost impossible for the teacher to go to the Wood Immortal Realm alone."

In the eyes of the people in the Immortal Realm, the Wood Fairy Realm is basically nothing.

As for alchemists, any alchemist with some skills will not choose to stay in the Wood Immortal Realm.

Obviously, as the closest student around Jordan Yang, Bai Lushuang also doesn't believe this.

"Bai, Senior Sister Bai, I,"

At this moment, when he heard Bai Lushuang's words, the disciple of the Alchemy Peak suddenly began to doubt it.

Yes, what is the teacher’s identity? How could he go to the Wood Fairy Realm?

Why am I so stupid? I believe this kind of news.

The other disciples of the Alchemy Peak also looked at him with a look of regret.

"Junior Brother Tao, you're done this time."

"Such fake news, you, alas."

"Hmph, stop talking nonsense, hurry up and pay me the alchemy furnace!"

Suddenly, the disciple of Dan Peak collapsed on the ground and cried, "Senior brothers and sisters, I, I'm sorry to you, I'm willing to be punished."

At the end of the day, he was already a little weak.

Hearing this, Bai Lushuang shook her head slightly and was about to speak.

A figure suddenly appeared at the entrance of the alchemy club, attracting Bai Lushuang's gaze.

"Teacher Tan?"

Seeing the person clearly, Bai Lushuang was slightly stunned, and quickly trembled and appeared at the entrance of the alchemy club.

Tan Songci.

Martial Arts Instructor.

"Oh? It's you girl. I didn't disturb you, right?"

Seeing Bai Lushuang, Tan Songci immediately showed a kind smile and spoke slowly.

But when he noticed that there was a mess of alchemy behind Bai Lushuang, Tan Songci couldn't help but be stunned.

"Teacher Tan, sorry, we,"

Seeing Tan Songci's gaze, Bai Lushuang was immediately embarrassed and embarrassed.

Upon hearing this, Tan Songci coughed lightly, changed the subject and said, "By the way, I am here to tell you. I am going to go to the Wood Fairy Realm. I wonder if you disciples of the Alchemy Peak are willing to go with me."

"Muxian Realm?"

Hearing this, Bai Lushuang's face changed.

An incredible thought emerged from my mind.

Could it be? !

Looking at Bai Lushuang's face, Tan Songci said with a puzzled look: "What, don't you know yet?"

"Your teacher is going to conduct an alchemy competition in the Wood Fairy Realm."

Tan Songci and Jordanyang have a good relationship in private.

So when he heard that Jordan Yang was going to compete with an alchemist in the Wood Fairy Realm, he was shocked and immediately decided to go and watch.

Of course, Tan Songci, a student from Jordanyang, did not forget it, so he came to pick them up in person.

As a student of Jordanyang, his teacher is going to compete, how can he miss it?

I have to say that Tan Songci was very considerate.

But at this moment, Bai Lushuang looked shocked.

Actually, it is true.

She never expected that her teacher would actually conduct an alchemy competition in the Wood Fairy Realm.

After being shocked, Bai Lushuang reacted instantly.

"Teacher Tan, go, we are willing to go to the Alchemy Peak."

Bai Lushuang's tone was a little anxious, as if she was afraid that Tan Songci would regret it.

Upon hearing this, Tan Songci nodded slightly.

"Then let's go immediately. Time doesn't wait for anyone, I'll wait for you outside."

After saying that, Tan Songci turned around and walked outside.

Bai Lushuang did not hesitate and hurried back to the alchemy club.

"Sister Bai, what happened? Isn't that Teacher Tan?"

Seeing Bai Lushuang come back, a disciple of the Alchemy Peak immediately stepped forward and asked.

Hearing this, Bai Lushuang took a deep breath, looked at the disciple of the Alchemy Peak who was sitting on the ground with a complicated look on his face and was slumped on his face.

The next moment, under the shocked gaze of everyone around him, Bai Lushuang reached out to help him up, and said with a little guilty guilt: "Sorry, Junior Brother Tao, it was Senior Sister who misunderstood you."

Upon hearing this, Junior Brother Tao was immediately flattered and waved his hand quickly, "No, there is no senior sister."

However, when he reacted, his face changed instantly.

etc,,,

Is the news true? !

Did the teacher really go to the Wood Fairy Realm? !

The other disciples of the Alchemy Peak reacted quickly, and they all looked unbelievable.

"Sister Bai, this,"

Although Bai Lushuang was also shocked, she nodded.

"Now, Teacher Tan is going to take us to the Muxian Realm to watch the teacher competition. Who would like to go there together?"
